title: Run one real JD as a baseline before further tooling
summary: Checkpoint order changed: after checkpoint-1 step 1, a baseline run of the current app on one real JD comes next; Lohith's judgment of that output drives later resume work.
body: Reason: work since checkpoint-0 built tooling (memory, hooks, supervisor) without improving the resume builder; AI-written tests do not give Lohith confidence, only real output he judges does. Change: checkpoint-6 is moved up as a BASELINE run of the current app as-is (its dependencies on checkpoint-3 and -5 are relaxed for this baseline only; the full end-to-end acceptance still depends on them). checkpoint-1 step 2 (real Codex task through the supervisor) is left to Lohith in his own Codex setup and does not block. All other checkpoints keep their order. Not ditched: the checkpoint system stays; this change is recorded to avoid drift. Paid model run: confirm JD and expected cost with Lohith immediately before running.

links.reason: Record plan changes with reason; keep old versions.

acceptance.user_statement: Okay, I, I like the plan to, you know, change uh, the things inside the checkpoint system.
